news.title: FOMO is why enterprises pay for GPUs they don't use — and why prices keep climbing
news.summary_raw: Enterprises can't fix their GPU waste problem because the fix makes the problem worse. Releasing idle capacity would improve utilization, but the same shortage driving GPU prices up is exactly why no team will give capacity back. So the fleet sits at roughly 5%, billed by the hour, and the cycle tightens.That pressure — repeated across thousands of enterprises over the past two years — is the reason most companies are now running their GPU fleets at roughly 5% utilization, according to Cast
news.summary: Enterprise GPUs often remain idle due to FOMO, driving up prices. Unused capacity can't be released because it would exacerbate the existing shortage.
news.enterprise_use: Enterprises use GPUs that they don't fully utilize due to fear of missing out on resources. This practice results in low utilization rates, such as 5%.
